teaser.en: Green turtles graze on it like cattle on a pasture, cropping the underwater meadows of the south coast.
teaser.sw: Kasa huila kama ng'ombe malishoni, wakizikata mbuga za chini ya maji za pwani ya kusini.
teaser.dg: Kasa a chijani anairya dza ng'ombe anavyorya nyasi marisani, anaikata nyasi hino ndani ya madzi pwani ya kusini.

summary.en: Turtle grass is a flowering plant that forms meadows on the intertidal and shallow sand flats. It feeds green turtles and dugongs and shelters the fish and octopus that coastal fishers rely on.
summary.sw: Nyasi bahari ya kasa (*turtle grass*) ni mmea unaotoa maua unaounda mbuga kwenye nyanda za mchanga zinazofunikwa na kufunuliwa na maji na zile zisizo na kina. Huwalisha kasa na nguva na huwahifadhi samaki na pweza ambao wavuvi wa pwani wanawategemea.
summary.dg: *Turtle grass* ni mmea wenye maruwa unaomera phamwenga phatu phanji kpwenye mtsanga unaofwinikpwa ni madzi wakati wa madzi ga kuodzala na unaosala wazi wakati wa madzi ga kala, na kpwenye mtsanga wa madzi machache. Inarisa kasa a chijani na nguva, na inafitsa ng'onda na pweza ambao avuvi a pwani anaakuluphira.

about.en:
Turtle grass is a true flowering plant that lives fully submerged in the sea. Its leaves are flat, slightly curved ribbons, rising in small clusters from creeping stems buried in the sand. Seen closely, the leaves are often speckled with tiny red-brown streaks.

In good conditions it forms thick, even meadows, sometimes mixed with other seagrasses.
about.sw:
Nyasi bahari ya kasa ni mmea halisi unaotoa maua unaoishi ukiwa umezama kabisa baharini. Majani yake ni riboni bapa zilizopinda kidogo, zinazoinuka katika mafungu madogo kutoka kwenye mashina yanayotambaa yaliyofukiwa mchangani. Ukiyaangalia kwa karibu, majani mara nyingi huwa na madoa madogo sana ya mistari ya kahawia-nyekundu.

Katika hali nzuri huunda mbuga nene na sawasawa, wakati mwingine zikichanganyika na nyasi bahari nyingine.
about.dg:
*Turtle grass* ni mmea wa kpweli wenye maruwa unaokala ndani ya bahari kabisa. Makodzage ni sambamba dza utepe unaomyoka chidide, na ganamera kpwa makundi madide kula kpwa mihi inayoambala iriyozikpwa mtsangani. Uchigalola phephi, mara nyinji makodza gana mistari midide ya rangi ya kundu na dongo.

Phatu phenye hali nono inamera nyinji na sawa-sawa, wakati wanjina phamwenga na nyasi zanjina za bahari.

where.en: It grows on intertidal and shallow subtidal sand flats. Seagrass meadows fringe Gazi Bay, Diani-Chale and Vanga-Shimoni. At low spring tides, parts of the meadows lie exposed or under a few centimetres of water, which is the easiest time to see it.
where.sw: Huota kwenye nyanda za mchanga zinazofunikwa na kufunuliwa na maji na zile zisizo na kina zilizo chini ya maji kupwa. Mbuga za nyasi bahari huzunguka Ghuba ya Gazi, Diani-Chale na Vanga-Shimoni. Wakati wa bamvua la maji kupwa, sehemu za mbuga huachwa wazi au chini ya sentimita chache za maji, na huo ndio wakati rahisi zaidi wa kuiona.
where.dg: Inamera kpwenye mtsanga unaosala wazi wakati wa madzi ga kala, na kpwenye mtsanga wa madzi machache usiosala wazi. Nyasi za bahari zinazunguluka kanda-kanda ya Gazi Bay, Diani-Chale na Vanga-Shimoni. Wakati wa madzi ga kala sana, seemu za nyasi hizi zinasala wazi au photsi ya madzi ga sentimita chache tu, kpwa hivyo ni rahisi zaidi kuiona wakati uhu.

uses.en: Its meadows are habitat for the rabbitfish, parrotfish, octopus and sea cucumbers that Digo fishers depend on. They also trap sediment, keep the water clear and help to protect beaches.
uses.sw: Mbuga zake ni makazi ya tafi, pono, pweza na majongoo bahari ambao wavuvi wa Kidigo wanawategemea. Pia hunasa mashapo, huweka maji safi na kusaidia kulinda fukwe.
uses.dg: Phatu phenye nyasi hizi ni makalo ga tsafi, phono, pweza na majongoo ga bahari ambao avuvi a Chidigo anaakuluphira. Piya zinagbwira mtsanga na ulongo unaohalwa ni madzi, zinahenda madzi gakale ereru, na zinaterya kurinda ufuwo.

names.en: No Digo name has been recorded yet. Swahili speakers usually call sea plants in general *mwani*. In English it is turtle grass, after the green turtles that graze it, and its scientific name is *Thalassia hemprichii*.
names.sw: Bado halijarekodiwa jina la Kidigo. Wazungumzaji wa Kiswahili kwa kawaida huita mimea ya baharini kwa jumla *mwani*. Kwa Kiingereza inaitwa *turtle grass*, kutokana na kasa wanaoila, na jina lake la kisayansi ni *Thalassia hemprichii*.
names.dg: Takuna dzina ra Chidigo ririroandikpwa hadi sambi. Atu anaogomba Chiswahili kpwa kawaida anaiha mimea yosi ya bahari *mwani*. Kpwa Chingereza inaihwa *turtle grass*, kpwa sababu ya kasa a chijani anaoirya, na dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Thalassia hemprichii*.

conservation.en: The seagrass meadows of Gazi Bay, Diani-Chale and Vanga-Shimoni are feeding grounds for dugongs, green turtles and rabbitfish, and nurseries for young fish.
conservation.sw: Mbuga za nyasi bahari za Ghuba ya Gazi, Diani-Chale na Vanga-Shimoni ni malisho ya nguva, kasa na tafi, na malezi ya samaki wachanga.
conservation.dg: Nyasi za bahari za Gazi Bay, Diani-Chale na Vanga-Shimoni ni phatu pha kurya pha nguva, kasa a chijani na tsafi, na ni phatu pha kukulira ng'onda adide.
